ecole.name: L'école : la salle de classe · School: the Classroom
ecole.alt: The village classroom painted in ink and gouache: the teacher reads standing on a blue mattress, a crayfish holds chalk, a sun in glasses gives a lesson at an easel, Monsieur Verbe listens to a white dove, reads with a prawn and bursts through a finish ribbon, a chalkboard on its own table, a goldfish pinning a card to the notice board, a globe with blue jelly, a young doe with a sack on her back and an exercise book folded into a kayak; an open green door on the left leads to the school garden, a half-open wooden door at the back shows the red curtains of the school theatre and a teal door on the right leads to the maths classroom.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Through the teal door to the maths classroom

doors.label: Le théâtre de l'école
doors.hint: Through the half-open wooden door to the school theatre

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Through the open green door to the school garden

zooms.label: la trousse
zooms.hint: Open the pencil case on the desk

items.scene: The fat blue pencil case on the desk waves its little white flag of TRUCE.
Monsieur Verbe (red beret) leans out of the window, a hand cupped by his ear, listening to the white dove.

trousse.name: La trousse · Pencil Case
trousse.alt: Close-up of the desk with the open blue pencil case: a ruler with a crown and red cape, a collie puppy with its paw stuck to a glue bottle, a pink eraser in a silver gum wrapper, a pencil in a rainbow crayon wrapper and scissors riding a tiny wooden seesaw.

maths.name: La classe de maths · Maths Class
maths.alt: The maths classroom painted in ink and gouache: a pyramid peering through a spyglass, a star wrapped in a towel, a ball in a blue bowl on a stool, a red arrow in a target with a lightning flash, Monsieur Verbe adding a giraffe to a toy zoo, dividing a pizza in goggles and flippers and measuring a tall sunflower, the teacher's desk in front, an orange hoop, a musical triangle, a smiling ice cube, a big abacus with a toy bull on top and a blue square driving a red toy car; the open door on the left leads back to the classroom and the open garden door at the back leads out to the playground.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the door to the classroom

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Go out through the garden door to the playground

zooms.label: le pupitre
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the teacher's desk

pupitre.name: Le pupitre · Desk
pupitre.alt: Close-up of the teacher's desk in the maths classroom: a purple line leaning on a little tightrope, half an orange in a bow tie, a slate with a sum drawn in chalk dots, a compass drawing a circle, a die in sunglasses holding up the sun and a golden sheaf of wheat with a tag of counting marks.

recre.name: La cour de récré · Playground
recre.alt: The sunny school playground painted in ink and gouache: twins in yellow dresses shrugging, a girl juggling six balls by a red see-saw, a farmer boy carrying eight sheaves of wheat on a pole (four on each side), a van with twenty crates in five rows of four, a tennis girl with seven balls in a row by her tipped-over basket, a toy boat sunk in a pond with five ducks, a mother cat with three kittens, a boy throwing three beanbags at a hoop, a boy pushing away a stack of nine pancakes, a girl holding up ten fingers, and in the bottom-left corner a little school fair with two striped stalls, a tombola wheel and a family walking up; the green door on the left leads back to the maths class.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the maths class

zooms.label: la kermesse
zooms.hint: Walk over to the school fair

kermesse.name: La kermesse · School Fair
kermesse.alt: The school fair painted in ink and gouache: families stroll between three striped stalls; an empty nest sits on the blue book stall roof, which holds nineteen books (ten above, nine below); a plush cat with a lit torch sits on the red sweets stall roof, with eighteen wrapped sweets in three rows of six beside an empty jar; the orange stall has a big oozing cheese and twelve slices; in front are a pyramid of fifteen cans, a tray of fifteen dice with two more stacked on top, and thirteen trays standing in a row; at the front a table-football game with eleven little players, a green parrot on its perch, a tombola wheel, a girl running with a windmill and spilled popcorn; the green door on the left leads back to the playground.

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the playground

theatre.name: Le théâtre de l'école · School Theatre
theatre.alt: The school theatre painted in ink and gouache: under bunting and spotlights a little diva in pink sings la-la-la, a boy lugs a big sack over his shoulder, a girl in a grass skirt wears many flower leis and a striped strongman lifts a huge iron weight; in front of the stage a child dressed as the Wizard of Oz in a green robe points to a row of little painted doors, a mime holds up one finger, a girl in pink holds up one giant wooden spoon and a boy hugs his teddy; a model village with a river, boats and a cathedral sits on a table on the left, rows of chairs face the stage, costumes hang on a rail the open door on the right leads back to the classroom and the open garden door on the left, by the bookcase, looks out onto the sports field and its red running track.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the open door to the classroom

doors.label: Le terrain de sport
doors.hint: Through the open garden door to the sports field

zooms.label: la maquette
zooms.hint: Look closely at the model village on the table

maquette.name: La maquette · The Model Village
maquette.alt: Close-up of the model village on the theatre table: two boys hold up their shiny fishing lures, a boy pushes his toy sailing ship along the river, a rowing boat waits with its oar, a little girl points at the model cathedral, a girl holds a bunch of daisies and a boy catches dew drops from a big leaf in his cup; tiny houses, a bridge, a street lamp and trees all around.

terrain.name: Le terrain de sport · Sports Field
terrain.alt: The school sports field painted in ink and gouache, ringed by a red running track: a big white van with twenty footballs on its roof rack in two rows of ten; a red toy train pulling three wagons, each heaped with ten yellow balls; a girl at a wooden table laid with four rows of ten carrots, a big black ant on the grass in front of it; a wooden boat on a round pond carrying five crates of ten red apples, an ant on top of its mast; a white swan at the back corner of a sandpit laid with six rows of ten white shells; a ginger cat beside four little white vans, each with twenty orange balls on its roof rack in four rows of five; children watching and playing; the white garden gate on the left leads back to the school theatre.

doors.label: Le théâtre
doors.hint: Back through the garden door to the theatre

jardin.name: Le jardin de l'école · School Garden
jardin.alt: The school garden painted in ink and gouache, a green lawn criss-crossed by brick paths: a moustached chef waves from the door of his little red-roofed hut; a girl in orange dungarees hides among three palms in wicker baskets; an old golfer in a flat cap putts his ball through a wire hoop on a putting green; a boy in board shorts stands on a wooden crate beside his surfboard; a girl dances inside her red hula hoop; a man in a brown suit stands in front of a blue sofa; a girl in a yellow raincoat runs to her kneeling grandpa; a girl drives a red pedal car; a boy in striped pyjamas sits under a little table that holds his bowl of soup; flowers everywhere; the open green door on the left leads back into the classroom and a small canteen with a blue door stands on the right.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the green door into the classroom

doors.label: La cantine
doors.hint: Through the blue door to the school canteen

cantine.name: La cantine · School Canteen
cantine.alt: The school canteen painted in ink and gouache, wooden floorboards and a big red woven rug: a butler in a tailcoat bows and steps aside so two grannies get the best view from the window; a girl switches on a glowing standing lamp; a boy at an easel paints a portrait of himself, a little mirror beside him; a girl rings a big brass hand bell; two friends at a little table share one bowl, each slurping an end of one long noodle; a boy holds up his wooden toy horse with a thumbs-up; a man with shaving suds on his cheeks shaves himself at a mirror and washbasin; a little girl holds out a teddy bear to you; long tables, benches and pans on the dresser; the open blue door on the left leads back to the school garden.

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the school garden
